question: What are the steps of the admission process for international applicants?
answer: International applicants go through a three-step process: Step 1 – Online Enrollment Application through the admissions portal; Step 2 – Placement Test & Online Interview; Step 3 – Acceptance Letter & Online Enrollment Confirmation. A step-by-step tutorial and application guidelines are available on the platform.
evidence: International applicants go through three-step process: Step 1 Online Enrollment Application Applicants must complete the online enrollment application through the admissions portal: Admissions Portal Fall Intake Application Deadline: 31.07.2026 Spring Intake Application Deadline: 30.11.2026 A step-by-step tutorial and application guidelines are available on the platform. To proceed with the application process, applicants are required to pay a Student Fee of 200 USD and upload the payment receipt to the admissions portal. To complete the application, applicants must upload scanned copies of the following documents: Passport Residence Permit (if applicable) Diploma (School Certificate) & Transcript Letter of Recommendation* Motivational Letter* Electronic photo (3 × 4 cm) IELTS (min 5.5 points) or SDU Extension Center (min B1 level) Certificate (if available) Student Fee Receipt Any additional documents (such as ISPT certificate, achievements, supporting documents, etc.) *Recommendation Letter — written by a teacher, employer, or academic representative to describe the applicant’s abilities, achievements, and potential. *Motivational Letter — written by the applicant to explain their interest in the program, goals, and motivation for studying at SDU University. Step 2 Placement Test & Online Interview 1. Placement Test ( English Entrance Exam) * Prospective students are expected to undertake a Placement Test and an interview in English. The Placement Test serves as an English Entrance Exam and requires successful completion before proceeding to the next step. * Applicants who possess an English language certificate such as IELTS 5.5 (each section min 5.0) or above may provide a scanned copy of the certificate to waive the Placement Test requirement. 2. Online Interview with Speciality Coordinator After completing the Placement Test, the speciality coordinator will contact the applicant to conduct an online interview. This interaction allows us to learn more about the applicant’s interests and academic objectives while assessing their suitability for the program. Step 3 Acceptance Letter & Online Enrollment Confirmation

question: Do international students need to nostrify their previous education documents?
answer: Yes. According to the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Order №600), all international students are required to complete the recognition (nostrification) procedure for their previous educational documents within the first semester of study. SDU University will provide guidance and support regarding the nostrification process after enrollment.

question: What conditions apply to SDU tuition discounts?
answer: The discounts apply to tuition fees only; retake / upgrade sessions and other additional services (e.g., language courses, dormitory accommodation, and meals) are charged at full price. All discounts, except social and partner-based discounts, are granted subject to maintaining a GPA of no less than 2.75 at the end of each academic year. Students entitled to discounts must submit their applications and supporting documents to the Registrar’s Office no later than the end of the first 2 weeks of the current semester.
